title: 第1095章 义无反顾第1094章 完美配合
lines: 话音落地，萧羽便是动了。
戮神的斩出的瞬间便是同时将五位半仙境同时圈入战圈当中。
顾北桥和万清慈瞬间便是明白的萧羽的答案。
“找死！”
顾北桥沉底的放弃了心中的那一点愧疚和对剑无名的情分，现在的他只想杀了萧羽抢夺世界之力，同时抓住剑无名逼问古剑修的修炼之法。
大战瞬间开启。
星空，被染成了浑浊的暗红，像是被生生撕开了一道流血的伤口。
苍穹碎裂，兵器交击产生的高温让虚空中充满了灼热的铁水的味道。
战场的中央，傲立着一道身影，她长发飞舞，脸颊之上是一道狰狞、血迹未干的伤口，伤口的血肉向外泛着，可是她的身躯依旧挺拔。
暗月手中的战枪的光芒已经有些暗淡，她就站在这里，极远处的星辰都似乎因为畏惧而远离。
“暗月！你连续的大战，现在的你已经是强弩之末了吧？你就算不为了自己，也该为你的族人想想！”
雷盂指着远处已经只剩下不到二十人的修罗族的天境强者道。
“如果我没有猜错的话，你修罗一脉本就人数稀少，死一位都是极大的损失，现在只要你们离开，我们绝不阻拦！”
雷盂的话，并没有遭到来自其它宇宙强者的反对，因为这些修罗都是些战斗狂人，一旦打起来就是不死不休，他们根本就不知道畏惧为何物。
暗月微微转头看向自己族人的方向，眼中第一次出现了一抹悲意。
绔屈看向暗月，他身上的黑袍早已破碎不堪，与身上的血肉粘连在一起。手中的双刀只有一柄还算完整，另外的一柄只剩下了半截刀身，脖颈上的伤，让他的脑袋微微有些歪，他甚至都没有时间服用丹药疗伤。
暗月眼睛微闭，稍稍喘了一口气，双目便是猛然睁开：“杀！！！”
手中的战枪再次扬起。
“杀了她！”
一众天境强者再次围了上来。
天武大陆萧家，简瑶瑶凌空而立，一双美目看着无尽的虚空，又看向遥远的神光大陆，眼中第一次出现了莫名的情绪。
她自小便是在仙界的仙王府长大，在见识过了天元宇宙的大战的之后，她突然觉得她以前的经历和生活，是多么的幸运。
她有数次想要出手帮助他们，不是因为她心善，而是他们那种明知必死依旧一往无前的画面，让她觉得，就算是天道，也应该给他们一丝生机。
这是对他们战死的灵魂的最后的成全。
现在萧府从上到下都空了，所有人都奔赴战场，无论老人还是幼童，他们离开的时候甚至还关照她，如果他们回不来了，这里的东西她可以随意带走，然后毁掉这里！
“大人！你能帮我解开禁制吗？”一道极其微弱又清晰的声音传到了简瑶瑶的中。
“怎么将她给忘记了。”简瑶瑶的思绪被唤回。
她知道在萧府关在一处院子当中关押着一位长着翅膀的女子，那女子很安静，每天只是看一些书籍，其它的什么也不做，甚至都不怎么修炼。
简瑶瑶有些奇怪，她不知道女子看得都是什么书，竟然让她如此废寝忘食，她曾从守卫的手中要来过一本那女子看完的书，竟然只是关于天武大陆历史的书。
content_en:
As soon as he finished speaking, Xiao Yu moved.
The moment God Killer slashed out, five and a half immortals were simultaneously trapped in the battle circle.
Gu Beiqiao and Wan Qingci immediately understood Xiao Yu's answer.
"Seeking death!"
Gu Beiqiao deeply gave up the guilt and affection for Jian Wuming in his heart. Now he just wanted to kill Xiao Yu and seize the power of the world, and at the same time, he caught Jian Wuming and asked him about the cultivation method of Gu Jianxiu.
The war started instantly.
The starry sky was dyed a turbid dark red, as if a bleeding wound had been torn open.
The sky shattered, and the high temperature generated by the clash of weapons filled the void with the smell of hot molten iron.
In the center of the battlefield, a figure stood proudly. Her long hair was flying, and there was a hideous wound with wet blood on her cheek. The flesh and blood from the wound was swollen outwards, but her body was still upright.
The light of the war gun in Dark Moon's hand has dimmed a bit. She is standing here, and the stars in the distance seem to stay away out of fear.
"Dark Moon! You have been fighting continuously. Now you are at the end of your strength, right? Even if you are not thinking about yourself, you should think about your people!"
Lei Men pointed at the Heaven Realm experts from the Shura tribe who had less than twenty people left in the distance.
"If I'm not wrong, your Shura lineage is already very small in number, and the death of one of you is a huge loss. Now as long as you leave, we will never stop you!"
Lei Yu's words were not opposed by the powerful men in other universes, because these Shura were all fighting madmen. Once they started fighting, they would fight to the death. They didn't know what fear was.
Dark Moon turned her head slightly to look in the direction of her tribe, with a trace of sadness appearing in her eyes for the first time.
Dan Qu looked at An Yue. The black robe on his body had long been torn to pieces and was stuck together with the flesh and blood on his body. Only one of the two swords in his hand was still intact, and only half of the blade of the other one was left. The injury on his neck made his head slightly tilted, and he didn't even have time to take pills to heal the injury.
Dark Moon closed her eyes slightly, took a breath, and suddenly opened her eyes: "Kill!!!"
The war gun in his hand was raised again.
"Kill her!"
A group of powerful people from the heavenly realm surrounded him again.
Jian Yaoyao stood in the sky from the Xiao family in the Tianwu Continent. Her beautiful eyes looked at the endless void and then at the distant Shenguang Continent. For the first time, inexplicable emotions appeared in her eyes.
She had grown up in the Immortal King's Mansion in the Immortal Realm since she was a child. After witnessing the battle in the Tianyuan Universe, she suddenly felt how lucky her previous experience and life had been.
She wanted to help them several times, not because she was kind-hearted, but because they knew they were going to die but still kept going forward, which made her feel that even God should give them a glimmer of life.
This is the final fulfillment of their souls who died in battle.
Now the Xiao Mansion is empty from top to bottom. Everyone is rushing to the battlefield, whether old or young. They even took care of her when they left. If they can't come back, she can take away the things here at will and then destroy the place!
"Sir! Can you help me unlock the restriction?" An extremely weak and clear voice came to Jian Yaoyao's heart.
"Why did you forget her?" Jian Yaoyao's thoughts were recalled.
She knew that a winged woman was imprisoned in a courtyard of the Xiao Mansion. The woman was very quiet. She just read some books every day and did nothing else, not even practicing much.
Jian Yaoyao was a little surprised. She didn't know what kind of books the woman read, which made her sleepless and forgetful about food. She once asked for a book from the guard that the woman had read, but it turned out to be just a book about the history of Tianwu Continent.
